dish: Lamb chops with mash and peas

canonicalIngredients.name: butter
observations: 2 tbsp to sear + 2 tbsp in sauce (s3)

canonicalIngredients.name: lemon
observations: 1/2 tsp juice + pinch zest in sauce (s3)

canonicalIngredients.name: chicken stock
observations: 1/2 cup in pan sauce, or white wine (s3)

causalSequence: peel, cube potatoes; boil in salted water 15 min until tender
drain; mash with hot milk, butter; season
heat peas with butter, splash water until hot
season chops; sear in hot oiled pan 4-6 min per side to liking
plate chops on mash, peas alongside
techniqueFacts: both US sources finish chops by thermometer: 145F medium rare, 160F medium, 170F well (s2, s3)
sear window 4-8 min per side on medium-high across pan-cooked sources (s2, s3)
both pea sources stir mint through the peas (s0, s1)
pea-mash variant: process hot peas, butter, water almost smooth (s0)
one source roasts chops and potatoes together 180C fan ~20 min (s1)
mash enrichments beyond milk-butter: cream cheese, parmesan (s2)
optional pan sauce from chop drippings: shallot, garlic, thyme, stock, butter, lemon (s3)
rest chops under foil while sauce is made (s3)
dish is naturally gluten free per one source (s3)
